Package guiContributor

Class ContributorValidator

java.lang.Object
guiContributor.ContributorValidator
public class ContributorValidator extends Object

Title: ContributorValidator Class.

Description: Provides static input validation and role ownership verification methods for Contributor Lesson Learned operations in Phase Two (TP2). Evaluates syntactic boundaries for title, description, category, author, and search query inputs, and enforces ownership authorization before update or delete operations are executed.

  • Method Details

    • validateTitle

      public static String validateTitle(String title)

      Method: validateTitle(String title)

      Description: Validates that a lesson title is non-null, not blank, and between 4 and 64 characters in length after trimming whitespace (TP2-REQ-02, US-HW2-01).

      Parameters:
      title - candidate title string provided by the contributor
      Returns:
      empty string if valid, or a descriptive error message if invalid

    • validateDescription

      public static String validateDescription(String description)

      Method: validateDescription(String description)

      Description: Validates that a lesson description body is non-null, not blank, and between 10 and 1000 characters in length after trimming whitespace (TP2-REQ-03, US-HW2-01).

      Parameters:
      description - candidate description body text
      Returns:
      empty string if valid, or a descriptive error message if invalid

    • validateCategory

      public static String validateCategory(String category)

      Method: validateCategory(String category)

      Description: Validates that the selected category is non-null, non-blank, not left on the default placeholder, and matches one of the approved technical categories (TP2-REQ-04).

      Parameters:
      category - candidate category string
      Returns:
      empty string if valid, or a descriptive error message if invalid

    • validateAuthor

      public static String validateAuthor(String author)

      Method: validateAuthor(String author)

      Description: Validates that the author username is non-null, non-blank, starts with a letter, and contains between 4 and 32 alphanumeric characters (TP2-REQ-04).

      Parameters:
      author - candidate contributor username
      Returns:
      empty string if valid, or a descriptive error message if invalid

    • validateSearchKeyword

      public static String validateSearchKeyword(String keyword)

      Method: validateSearchKeyword(String keyword)

      Description: Validates search query strings to ensure they do not exceed the maximum allowed length of 64 characters (TP2-REQ-06, US-HW2-02). Blank keywords are permitted and return the full collection.

      Parameters:
      keyword - candidate search query string
      Returns:
      empty string if valid, or a descriptive error message if invalid

    • validateLessonFields

      public static String validateLessonFields(String title, String description, String author, String category)

      Method: validateLessonFields(String title, String description, String author, String category)

      Description: Evaluates all fields required to create or update a LessonLearned entity in sequential priority order (TP2-REQ-01 through TP2-REQ-04).

      Parameters:
      title - candidate title
      description - candidate description
      author - candidate author username
      category - candidate category
      Returns:
      empty string if all fields are valid, or the first encountered error message

    • verifyModifyPermission

      public static String verifyModifyPermission(LessonLearned lesson, User actingUser)

      Method: verifyModifyPermission(LessonLearned lesson, User actingUser)

      Description: Verifies whether the active logged-in User has permission to update or delete the specified LessonLearned record (TP2-REQ-09, TP2-REQ-11, US-HW2-03, US-HW2-04). Modification is permitted only if the acting user is the original author or holds the Administrator role.

      Parameters:
      lesson - target LessonLearned record to modify or delete
      actingUser - currently authenticated User attempting the operation
      Returns:
      empty string if authorized, or a descriptive authorization error message
